title: Zero-offset symbol query
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $A$ assign a Boolean answer to each state-or-symbol query and each pair of natural-number indices. For any optional tape index $\tau$ and time $t$, the signed query at offset zero equals the symbol query with the negative-sign flag set to false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols
A Boolean-valued answer function on queries and two natural-number indices
